definitions.explanation: A Japanese dish made by steaming a seasoned egg mixture with dashi in a cup-like bowl. It contains ingredients such as chicken, shrimp, mushrooms, and ginkgo nuts. Served warm as a side dish in Japanese cuisine.

examples.japanese: {茶碗蒸|ちゃわんむ}しが{大好|だいす}きだ。
{寿司屋|すしや}で{茶碗蒸|ちゃわんむ}しを{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: I ordered chawanmushi at the sushi restaurant.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}の{作|つく}る{茶碗蒸|ちゃわんむ}しは、{具|ぐ}がたっぷり{入|はい}っていて{美味|おい}しい。
examples.english: My grandmother's chawanmushi is delicious, packed full of ingredients.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
A classic Japanese dish often served at {寿司屋|すしや} (sushi restaurants) and in {懐石料理|かいせきりょうり} (traditional multi-course meals). The name literally means "tea bowl steamed" — {茶碗|ちゃわん} (tea bowl/cup) + {蒸|む}し (steaming). Common ingredients include {鶏肉|とりにく} (chicken), {海老|えび} (shrimp), {椎茸|しいたけ} (shiitake mushrooms), {銀杏|ぎんなん} (ginkgo nuts), and {三|み}つ{葉|ば} (mitsuba herb).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {茶碗蒸|ちゃわんむ}しを{作|つく}る (to make chawanmushi)
- {茶碗蒸|ちゃわんむ}しの{具|ぐ} (chawanmushi ingredients)
